Create or close a workbook session

Source: R/sp_workbook.R
sp_workbook_session_create.Rd

Usage

sp_workbook_session_create(x, ..., persist_changes = TRUE, call = caller_env())

sp_workbook_session_close(x, session_id, ..., call = caller_env())

Arguments

x

A SharePoint or OneDrive Excel workbook. Can be a ms_drive_item object, a SharePoint URL, or a path passed to get_sp_item().

...

Additional parameters passed to get_sp_item() if x is not a ms_drive_item object.

persist_changes

If TRUE (default), changes made in the session are saved to the workbook.

call

The execution environment used in error messages. Defaults to the environment of the calling function.

session_id

A workbook session ID from sp_workbook_session_create().

Value

sp_workbook_session_create() returns a session ID. sp_workbook_session_close() returns x invisibly.

Details

Use a session to make several requests to a workbook. Requests without a session are sent in a new temporary session by the API. If persist_changes = FALSE, changes made in the session are discarded when it is closed. A session that isn't closed expires after a few minutes.

Requests in the same session see each other's changes immediately. Requests sent without a session may not (see "Reading after writing" in sp_workbook).

See also

Other workbooks: local_sp_workbook_session(), sp_workbook
